title: HBM Market Size Forecast by Generation (2026-2032)
executive_question: How will the HBM market evolve across generations from 2026 to 2032?
required_metrics: HBM market revenue by generation (HBM3E, HBM4, HBM4E) for years 2026-2032 (USD billions)
HBM unit shipments by generation (millions of units) for years 2026-2032
Average selling price (ASP) per HBM unit by generation (USD) for years 2026-2032
preferred_sources: SK hynix, Samsung, Micron annual reports
search_queries: HBM market size forecast 2026 2032 by generation
data_quality_rule: Use annual data points from the same source for consistency. If only two endpoints are available, apply a transparent CAGR and mark intermediate values as estimates.
narrative_role: Establishes the overall market opportunity and the shift from HBM3E to HBM4/HBM4E.
pre_exhibit_context: The report argues that HBM4/HBM4E will dominate AI accelerator memory by 2028, but we need to quantify the market size and adoption timeline.
post_exhibit_takeaway: The HBM market is projected to grow from $X billion in 2026 to $Y billion by 2032, with HBM4/HBM4E accounting for the majority of revenue by 2028.

title: CoWoS Capacity and Utilization by Supplier (2026-2032)
executive_question: How will CoWoS capacity and utilization evolve across suppliers from 2026 to 2032?
required_metrics: CoWoS monthly capacity (in 300mm wafer equivalents) for TSMC, Samsung, and others for years 2026-2032
CoWoS utilization rate (%) for each supplier for years 2026-2032
CoWoS capacity expansion announcements (additional wafers per month) with year
data_quality_rule: Use official company announcements for capacity figures. If utilization rates are not disclosed, estimate based on demand forecasts and mark as estimates.
narrative_role: Quantifies the CoWoS bottleneck and the impact of capacity expansion on supply availability.
pre_exhibit_context: The report claims CoWoS packaging will remain a critical bottleneck through 2026-2027, but capacity expansion will ease supply by 2028. We need to show the capacity trajectory.
post_exhibit_takeaway: TSMC's CoWoS capacity is expected to grow from X thousand wafers per month in 2026 to Y thousand by 2032, with utilization rates remaining above 90% until 2028.

title: Yield Learning Curves for HBM Generations
executive_question: How do HBM4 yields compare to previous generations over time?
required_metrics: HBM yield rate (%) for HBM2E, HBM3E, HBM4 for years 2020-2032 (annual data points)
Yield improvement rate (percentage points per year) for each generation
Time to reach mature yield (years from start of production)
data_quality_rule: Use historical yield data for HBM2E/HBM3E from credible sources. For HBM4, use analyst forecasts and mark as estimates. Ensure at least 4 annual data points per generation.
narrative_role: Supports the yield economics argument by showing the expected yield ramp for HBM4 relative to HBM3E.
pre_exhibit_context: The report hypothesizes that HBM4 initial yields will be lower but improve rapidly. We need to visualize the yield learning curve.
post_exhibit_takeaway: HBM4 yields are expected to start at X% in 2026 and improve to Y% by 2028, following a similar learning curve to HBM3E but with a steeper ramp.

title: Geopolitical Risk Heatmap for HBM and CoWoS Supply Chain
executive_question: Which regions pose the highest geopolitical risk to HBM and CoWoS supply chains?
required_metrics: HBM production share by country (South Korea, US, etc.) for 2026 (percentage)
CoWoS production share by country (Taiwan, US, etc.) for 2026 (percentage)
Geopolitical risk index score by country (e.g., from World Bank, Economist Intelligence Unit) for 2026
Supply chain concentration (e.g., Herfindahl-Hirschman Index) for HBM and CoWoS
comparison_set: Countries: Taiwan, South Korea, US, Japan, China, others
search_queries: geopolitical risk index semiconductor supply chain 2026
data_quality_rule: Use official or widely cited risk indices. Production shares should be based on actual capacity data from industry reports. If risk index is not available, use a qualitative assessment and mark as such.
narrative_role: Visualizes the concentration of supply and the risk exposure across regions.
pre_exhibit_context: The report argues that geopolitical risks, particularly US-China tensions and Taiwan's centrality, will drive supply chain diversification. We need to show the risk landscape.
post_exhibit_takeaway: Taiwan and South Korea are high-risk, high-supply-concentration regions, while the US and Japan offer lower risk but limited current capacity.

title: HBM and CoWoS Market Size by Segment (2026-2032)
executive_question: What is the market size for HBM and CoWoS by application segment?
required_metrics: HBM revenue by segment (data center AI accelerators, HPC, networking, others) for years 2026, 2028, 2030, 2032 (USD billions)
CoWoS revenue by segment (same segments) for years 2026, 2028, 2030, 2032 (USD billions)
AI accelerator unit shipments by segment (millions of units) for years 2026-2032
comparison_set: Segments: Data center AI accelerators, HPC, Networking, Others
data_quality_rule: Use consistent segment definitions across sources. If segment splits are not available, use top-down estimates and mark as estimates.
narrative_role: Breaks down the market opportunity by end-use segment (data center AI accelerators, HPC, etc.) to inform investment decisions.
pre_exhibit_context: The report needs to quantify the demand drivers for HBM and CoWoS. We need to show which segments will drive growth.
post_exhibit_takeaway: Data center AI accelerators will account for over 80% of HBM and CoWoS demand by 2032, growing at a CAGR of X%.

title: Investment and Capacity Expansion Timeline for HBM and CoWoS
executive_question: What are the key investment and capacity expansion milestones for HBM and CoWoS from 2026 to 2032?
required_metrics: Announced capacity expansion projects for HBM and CoWoS with start year and expected completion year
Investment amount (USD billions) for each project
Expected additional capacity (wafers per month or units per year) for each project
comparison_set: Companies: TSMC, SK hynix, Samsung, Micron, others
data_quality_rule: Use official announcements for project details. If exact dates are not available, use the year of announcement and expected production start.
narrative_role: Shows the timeline of capacity additions and investments to assess supply-side response.
pre_exhibit_context: The report needs to evaluate the supply-side response to demand. We need to see when new capacity will come online.
post_exhibit_takeaway: Major capacity expansions are expected from TSMC, SK hynix, and Samsung between 2026 and 2028, with significant investments in new fabs and packaging lines.

title: Cost per Package and Yield Sensitivity Analysis for HBM4
executive_question: How does yield variation impact the cost per HBM4 package?
required_metrics: HBM4 cost per package (USD) at different yield levels (e.g., 50%, 60%, 70%, 80%, 90%) for a given year (e.g., 2026)
HBM4 manufacturing cost breakdown (materials, labor, depreciation, etc.) in USD per package
HBM4 ASP (USD) for comparison
preferred_sources: Industry cost models (e.g., IC Insights, SemiEngineering)
Academic papers on semiconductor cost modeling
search_queries: HBM4 cost per package yield sensitivity
data_quality_rule: Use a transparent cost model based on public data. If exact cost data is not available, use estimates from industry experts and clearly label as estimates.
narrative_role: Quantifies the economic impact of yield on HBM4 cost, supporting the yield economics argument.
pre_exhibit_context: The report argues that yield improvements will reduce costs by 2028. We need to show the cost sensitivity to yield.
post_exhibit_takeaway: A 10 percentage point improvement in yield can reduce cost per package by X%, making yield management critical for profitability.
